title: Admissibility Boundary Dynamics
purpose: Define ordinal-only admissibility boundary dynamics for mismatch transitions without introducing numerical metrics, topology, units, scalar thresholds, or continuous fields.
summary: This patch governs how ordinal mismatch evaluations behave as they approach, contact, cross, retreat from, or persist near admissibility boundaries. It extends the transition discipline introduced by PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_055 while preserving the qualitative-only status of the metric bridge.

basis.scope: Define ordinal-only admissibility boundary dynamics for mismatch transitions. The basis is additive and documentary, extending the governed ordinal transition discipline introduced by PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_055 while leaving RT_core unchanged and keeping quantitative metric construction deferred.

core_rule.statement: Boundary dynamics classify approach, contact, crossing, retreat, and persistence as ordinal governed states under a declared admissibility boundary; they do not introduce numeric thresholds, units, topology, or metric magnitude.

AdmBoundary.definition: A declared admissibility condition separating lawful continuation from inadmissible continuation within a specified domain, scale, and coupling context.

BoundaryApproach.definition: A governed ordinal transition pattern indicating movement toward a declared admissibility boundary under repeated Delta evaluation.

BoundaryContact.definition: The first evaluated condition satisfying the declared admissibility-boundary contact rule.
BoundaryContact.note: Contact does not by itself imply admissibility break.

BoundaryCrossing.definition: A transition across a declared admissibility boundary.

BoundaryRetreat.definition: A governed transition pattern indicating movement away from a previously approached or contacted admissibility boundary.

BoundaryPersistence.definition: Repeated boundary contact or near-boundary classification without immediate admissibility break.

formal_reading.delta_role: Delta evaluates mismatch under a declared symmetry-reference coupling.
formal_reading.boundary_role: PATCH_PI_RT_CALCULUS_056 governs the admissibility-boundary behavior of those transitions.
formal_reading.separation_rule: Delta evaluation, ordinal classification, transition discipline, and boundary dynamics remain distinct governed layers.

textbook_integration.recommended_location: Chapter 2 or Chapter 7, immediately after ordinal mismatch transition discipline.
textbook_integration.integration_note: This patch should be presented as the next qualitative layer after ordinal transition discipline and before any continuous mismatch field is introduced.

forbidden_inferences: BoundaryApproach does not imply numeric distance.
BoundaryContact does not imply scalar equality.
BoundaryCrossing does not imply spatial crossing.
BoundaryPersistence does not imply topological stability.
No ordinal boundary state licenses metric magnitude.

required_repo_changes.description: Add the boundary-dynamics witness that declares the ordinal boundary states and separation rules.
Add the trace schema that records boundary approach, contact, crossing, retreat, and persistence without numeric magnitude.
Add the counterexample that blocks numeric threshold and topology readings of boundary behavior.

success_criteria: Boundary contact and crossing are trace-explicit.
governance_notes: This patch extends the metric bridge but does not introduce quantitative metrics.
This patch does not modify RT_core.
This patch does not promote projection from provisional status.
This patch prepares the path toward continuous mismatch field construction without defining that field.
